messages:
Maya (Product): Thanks for the all-hands — quick follow-ups on sequencing and success metrics for the features we flagged (serving controls + console UX + Optimize recommendations). I want to make sure teams have clear dates and owners.

Maya (Product): Q1) Does the planned canary for serving controls happen before SDK v1.3 branch cut or after? We need to know to avoid breaking the SDK integration.

Samir (CTO): Short answer: before. We want the canary to validate runtime fallbacks and model-variant routing before we freeze SDK APIs.

Ravi (Eng): To add: infra needs a stable canary window of 10 business days to surface perf regressions with live traffic profiles.

Claire (PM): Q2) How will we measure canary success? Is it just latency+errors or do we include cost/unit and quality regressions?

Samir (CTO): Primary signals: 1) p95 latency within SLA, 2) error rate delta < 0.1% absolute, 3) model output quality regression < 1% on the eval suite we agreed on. Cost/unit will be monitored but won't block GA unless it doubles.

Liu (CEO): Keep product owners informed daily during the canary. If anything drifts, we pause and triage. Good to have a single async status doc. :+1:

Maya (Product): Noted. I'll own the status doc. Claire/Ravi — can you confirm the eval suite link and owner?

Claire (PM): Eval suite is the `serving-controls-smoke` set — owner @Claire. I'll share the runbook in the doc.

Jordan (Infra): Ops note: we need feature flags to be togglable per-customer for the canary (we already have the flag scaffold). Estimated delivery for per-customer targeting: 2026-05-10.

Maya (Product): Draft timeline I sketched:
```
Canary window: 2026-05-15 -> 2026-05-29
SDK v1.3 branch cut: 2026-06-01
GA target: 2026-06-30
Console UX surface for Optimize recs (beta): 2026-06-15
```
Can everyone call out blockers to these dates?

Ravi (Eng): Blockers: 1) KV cache invalidation bug reproduction under burst (tracking PR #1421), 2) end-to-end telemetry for prefix cache hit ratio (needs a small agent change). Both are on our sprint and should be clear by 2026-05-08 unless we see new flaky tests.

Samir (CTO): Also add: quantized model fallback tests — we need to run a 48h soak on staging GPUs to catch intermittent hangs. Plan to start soak 2026-05-05.

DeployBot: Notice: Canary orchestration scheduled for 2026-05-15 09:00 UTC (initiated by Jordan).

Maya (Product): Thanks — that helps. Claire, can you put together a short acceptance checklist (ops + product + infra) we can sign-off on before the canary start?

Claire (PM): Yes — will post checklist by EOD 2026-05-07. Items: eval run, dashboards (latency, errors, quality), rollback playbook, owner roster.

Liu (CEO): One more: for the console UX, let's be explicit about MVP scope. We want in-console Optimize recommendations for token-level batching suggestions + one-click apply to service config. No redesigns — keep it product-lite.

Maya (Product): Agreed. MVP scope noted: cost recommendations + suggested batching config + apply CTA. Beta visible to Dedicated/Private first.

Ravi (Eng): Implementation detail: apply CTA will trigger a config push to the routing layer. We'll implement a dry-run flag initially.

Samir (CTO): Action items recap (I'll DM owners for clarity):
- Maya: status doc + timeline (owner)
- Claire: acceptance checklist + eval runs (owner)
- Jordan: per-customer toggles + canary orchestration (owner)
- Ravi: fix KV cache bug PR #1421 + telemetry (owner)
- Samir: 48h quantized model soak (owner)

Maya (Product): I'll create the status doc and invite owners. Thanks everyone. If there are new blockers post-EOD, drop them here.

DeployBot: Canary started: 2026-05-15T09:12:03Z — traffic ramp 10% -> 100% over 6h.

Ravi (Eng): Noted — watching traces. Ping me if you see p95 > 300ms.

Claire (PM): Uploaded acceptance checklist: https://redwood.internal/ci/docs/serving-controls-checklist (owner: Claire)

Maya (Product): Closing note: we'll do a brief post-canary review in all-hands follow-up. Likely a 15-min slot next week. Thanks! :sparkles:
